name: Dealers Trade v 7.91 ZeroLag MACD
summary: This EA trades based on ZeroLag MACD crossover signals, entering positions when the MACD line crosses the signal line with zero-lag filtering to reduce indicator lag. It incorporates position management with stop loss and take profit levels, and uses the Dealers Trade framework for order execution and trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ZeroLag MACD交叉信号进行交易，当MACD线穿越信号线时入场，采用零滞后滤波减少指标延迟。它结合了止损和止盈水平进行仓位管理，并使用Dealers Trade框架进行订单执行和交易管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ZeroLag MACD指标捕捉动量变化，ZeroLag MACD通过双重EMA去滞后算法减少传统MACD的延迟问题，使信号更及时。入场条件为MACD主线与信号线交叉，配合零轴过滤确认趋势方向，多头交叉且MACD在零轴上方时做多，空头交叉且在零轴下方时做空。出场条件包括固定止损止盈、反向信号平仓以及可选的追踪止损功能。仓位管理支持固定手数和基于账户风险的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损控制等参数，防止过度暴露风险。整体策略属于典型的动量跟踪系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA leverages the ZeroLag MACD indicator to capture momentum shifts, where the ZeroLag MACD reduces traditional MACD lag through a dual-EMA de-lagging algorithm for more timely signals. Entry conditions require the MACD main line crossing the signal line, combined with a zero-line filter to confirm trend direction: long entries when the bullish crossover occurs above the zero line, and short entries when the bearish crossover occurs below the zero line. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, closing positions on reverse signals, and an optional trailing stop feature. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and risk-based dynamic lot calculation tied to account equity. Money management features include maximum position limits and daily maximum loss controls to prevent excessive risk exposure. The overall strategy is a classic momentum-following system best suited for trending market conditions.

pros: ZeroLag MACD有效减少传统MACD的信号延迟，提高入场及时性
提供基于风险的动态仓位管理，可根据账户资金自动调整手数
包含每日最大亏损限制和最大持仓控制，具备基本的风险防护框架
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性强，便于优化和回测
Dealers Trade框架提供稳定的订单执行和滑点处理机制
pros_en: ZeroLag MACD effectively reduces traditional MACD signal lag, improving entry timeliness
Risk-based dynamic position sizing automatically adjusts lot size according to account equity
Includes daily maximum loss limit and maximum position control, providing a basic risk protection framework
Clear and understandable strategy logic with highly adjustable parameters for optimization and backtesting
Dealers Trade framework provides stable order execution and slippage handling mechanisms
cons: MACD类策略在震荡市场中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
默认止损止盈为0，如果不手动设置则交易风险极高
缺乏市场波动率过滤机制（如ATR滤波），在低波动率时段可能产生不利入场
没有多时间框架确认，单一周期信号可靠性有限
未包含点差过滤，在高点差环境下信号质量会下降
cons_en: MACD-type strategies tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Default stop loss and take profit are set to 0, creating extremely high trading risk if not manually configured
Lacks volatility filtering mechanism (e.g., ATR filter), potentially producing unfavorable entries during low volatility periods
No multi-timeframe confirmation, limiting signal reliability on a single timeframe
Does not include spread filtering, signal quality degrades in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加ATR波动率过滤和点差过滤，避免在不利市场条件下开仓
加入多时间框架确认机制，例如H4趋势方向与H1入场信号对齐后再入场
增加震荡市场识别（如ADX或布林带宽度），在横盘时暂停交易或切换策略
improvements_en: Add ATR volatility filter and spread filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable market conditions
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., entering only when H4 trend direction aligns with H1 entry signals
Add ranging market identification (e.g., ADX or Bollinger Band width) to pause trading or switch strategies during sideways markets

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，若不手动设置则完全没有风险保护
缺乏震荡市场过滤，MACD在横盘行情中容易频繁虚假信号
单一时间框架信号无确认机制，假突破风险较高
未设点差过滤，高点差可能直接吃掉小止盈
risk_points_en: Default stop loss and take profit are 0, providing absolutely no risk protection if not manually configured
Lacks ranging market filter, MACD prone to frequent false signals during sideways markets
Single timeframe signal without confirmation mechanism, high risk of false breakouts
No spread filter, high spreads can directly consume small take profit targets

It incorporates position management with stop loss and take profit levels, and uses the Dealers Trade framework for order execution and trade management.
